extDescription.message: Group, save, and restore your tabs — Safari-style tab groups for Chrome.

dragTabTitle.message: Drag to reorder, or onto a group to move

spDockHint.message: To move this panel to the left, right-click the panel and choose “Show on left” (or Chrome Settings → Appearance → Side panel).

spSaveGroupTitle.message: Save the tab group the active tab belongs to

spEmptySub.message: Save the current window or tab group to get started.

spActiveBadgeTitle.message: These tabs belong to the saved group "$1"

spNothingToSave.message: Nothing to save in this window.

spNotInGroup.message: Active tab isn't in a group.

mgSyncTitle.message: Sync groups to your Google account so they appear on every device you're signed into (small storage limit — see README).

mgKeepLive.message: Keep workspaces live in the background

mgKeepLiveTitle.message: On: the workspace you leave keeps running as a Chrome tab group, so switching back is instant — but Chrome lists every live tab group in the bookmarks bar. Off: Tabinet never creates tab groups, so nothing appears in the bookmarks bar; workspaces reopen (pre-warmed) when you switch back. Individual workspaces can override this.

mgPreload.message: Pre-load tabs when a workspace opens

mgPreloadTitle.message: On: when a workspace opens, Tabinet loads its tabs in the background a few at a time, so clicking a tab shows an already-loaded page instead of waiting for it. Off: tabs stay unloaded until you click them (lighter on memory), and are only network-warmed.

mgAutoSaveChangesTitle.message: On: when a tab in the active workspace navigates, the saved workspace follows it, so it reopens where you left off. Off: each saved tab keeps the URL it was saved with.

mgAutoSaveCount.message: Auto-save tabs you add or close

mgAutoSaveCountTitle.message: On: tabs you open or close in the active workspace are added to / removed from the saved workspace. Off: the saved workspace keeps the number of tabs it was saved with — navigation is still saved if the option above is on.

mgBookmarksHint.message: Chrome's own bookmarks bar row can be hidden entirely: right-click the bookmarks bar and uncheck Show tab groups.

mgImportModeTitle.message: How Load JSON applies the file

mgSidebarEmpty.message: No groups yet. Create one above.

mgNoGroupsSub.message: Create a group on the left to start adding tabs.

mgSelectSub.message: Pick a group on the left to view and edit its tabs.

mgKeepSelectTitle.message: Live: this workspace keeps running as a Chrome tab group when you switch away (instant to come back to, but Chrome shows it in the bookmarks bar). Close on switch: its tabs are saved and closed, leaving nothing behind.

mgTabsEmpty.message: No tabs in this group yet. Add one below.

mgTip.message: Tip: drag ⋮⋮ to reorder tabs, or drag a tab onto a group on the left to move it there.

mgToastPreloadOn.message: Tabs load in the background when a workspace opens — clicking one is instant.

mgToastPreloadOff.message: Tabs load only when you click them — lighter on memory, slower on first click.

mgToastChangesOn.message: Saved workspaces follow their tabs as you browse.

mgToastChangesOff.message: Saved tabs keep the URL they were saved with.

mgToastCountOn.message: Tabs you open or close are saved to the workspace.

mgToastCountOff.message: The saved workspace keeps its tab count; opening or closing tabs won't change it.

mgToastKeepOn.message: Workspaces stay live in the background — Chrome shows them in the bookmarks bar.

mgToastKeepOff.message: Workspaces close when you switch away — nothing left in the bookmarks bar.

mgToastSyncOn.message: Sync enabled — groups now live in your Google account.

mgToastSyncOff.message: Sync disabled — groups now stored on this device only.

mgToastSyncFail.message: Couldn't enable sync: too much data for sync storage (~100KB limit). Kept local.

mgToastAreaFail.message: Couldn't switch storage. Kept previous setting.

mgLoadFailed.message: Load failed: not a valid Tabinet JSON file.

aboutTagline.message: Group, save, and restore your tabs.
